confirmed_data.title: Furvise Vet Visit Brief
confirmed_data.disclaimer: Prepared from information recorded by the pet owner in Furvise. It may be incomplete and does not contain a diagnosis or replace veterinary assessment.
confirmed_data.visitSummary: Rabies vaccination was documented on 2023-09-13 with same-evening facial swelling that resolved the same evening; no breathing difficulty was recorded, and the clinic noted a next due date of 2026-09-13. Creatinine was 1.1 mg/dL (reference 0.5-1.6) on 2023-06-01 and 1.4 mg/dL (0.5-1.6) on 2026-08-28, with no kidney diagnosis documented. Prednisone was recorded as 5 mg daily from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-05, then 2.5 mg daily from 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-10; itching improved on 2026-09-08 and was reported to have returned on 2026-09-12.
confirmed_data.reasonForVisit: Vaccination consultation with a prior rabies reaction and recent itching after prednisone.
